title: Finding your way around
intro: Every page in Depot has the same top bar and left rail. Home sums up what is happening in your workspace.

sections.heading: The top bar
text: The search box sits at the left of the top bar.
steps: Click the search box to find files. See “Searching and asking questions”.

sections.heading: The right side of the top bar
steps: Click **Status** to check that Depot is running normally.
Click the Meetings icon, a video camera, to see who is online and call them.
Click the bell to see your **Notifications**.
Click the gear to open **Settings**, for your profile, appearance and notifications.
bullets: Click the sun or moon icon to switch between light and dark. See “Light or dark: making Depot comfortable”.
Click your name, for example **Jordan Lee**, to open a menu with **Sign out**.

sections.heading: The left rail
bullets: **Home**, **Files**, **Favorites**, **Shared with me**, **My links** and **Trash** open those pages.
**Files** shows the library you have open. A library is a set of files and folders, like a shared drive.
Click the library name at the top of the rail to switch libraries. Click the star next to one to pin it under **Pinned**.
**Quick access**, further down, lists files you opened recently, newest first.

sections.heading: Home
text: Home opens when you sign in. Click **Home** in the left rail to come back to it.
steps: **Files** shows how many files you have, and how that is changing.
**Storage** shows how much space you are using.
**Shared** counts files others added, and your live links.
**Libraries** shows how many libraries you can open.

sections.heading: Your libraries
steps: **Your libraries** lists your own libraries, with **Upload** and **New folder** buttons. **Shared with you** and **Recent files** sit below it.
